description: Stop-by-stop scheduled timetable for one specific Japanese train run, by railway and train number: every station it calls at with arrival/departure time. Covers Tokyo Metro, JR East, Toei and other Japan railway operators. Train numbers come from odpt_station_timetable rows. Needs an ODPT developer consumer key via _apiKey; Pipeworx supplies one if omitted. Example: odpt_train_timetable({ railway: "odpt.Railway:JR-East.Yamanote", train_number: "1234G" }).

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own ODPT developer consumer key. Pipeworx supplies one if omitted.

train_number.description: The train number as shown in a station timetable row, e.g. "1234G".

name: odpt_train_timetable
title: Odpt Train Timetable
